speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me if you have a family history of bleeding disorders, and do you experience prolonged bleeding after minor cuts or dental procedures?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of joint bleeding or hemarthrosis, and do you recall any specific bleeding episodes during infancy or early childhood?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Do you personally have a history of joint bleeding (hemarthrosis), and have you ever required transfusions for bleeding episodes?
REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Prothrombin Time: 15 sec, Partial Thromboplastin Time: 60 sec, Bleeding Time: 6 min, Fibrin Split Products: Negative

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prolonged PTT and family history, I suspect a factor deficiency. Have you ever experienced spontaneous bleeding into your joints or deep muscles? REQUEST TEST: Factor VIII and Factor IX Levels

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Factor VIII Level: 5% (Normal: 50-150%), Factor IX Level: 85% (Normal: 50-150%)

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the prolonged PTT and severely reduced Factor VIII levels, you have Hemophilia A. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A
